items.name: tokens
items.title: MetalUI tokens
items.description: Soft Hardware colorways (bone, graphite), materials, caps and springs as --mu-* custom properties. Every component imports it.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A press-in pill button. It sinks 1px into a well while held and springs back on release. It comes with standard, primary and destructive caps.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/button.md. SwiftUI: MetalButton in the MetalUI Swift package.

items.name: selection-frame
items.title: Selection frame
items.description: KAMUI-14, the one selection for every kind of object: a 1.25 green ring with a flat collar at offset 6, eight handles on the ring line, and a graphite readout of the measured frame. Hover shows only faint corner dots and an edge light.
items.docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/selection-frame.md. SwiftUI: MetalSelectionFrame in the MetalUI Swift package.
